name: recordPatientConsent
shortDescription: Records and updates patient consent for legal policies and data usage within the portal.
description:
Overview

Records and updates patient consent for various legal policies (e.g., Terms of Use, Privacy Policy) and data usage. This ensures compliance with legal and privacy requirements.

Intended use

Called by the patient-facing UI when a patient grants or revokes consent for a specific policy or data usage. Parameters include the patient ID, consent type, version, and status. It returns the updated consent record.

Logic

  1. Validate the input parameters, ensuring a valid patient ID, consent type, version, and status are provided.
  2. Query the ConsentRecord entity to check for an existing consent record for the given patient and consent type.
  3. If an existing record is found, update its status and consentDate using ctx.data.update.
  4. If no existing record is found, create a new ConsentRecord using ctx.data.create.
  5. Audit-log the consent action with ctx.audit.log, including the patient ID, consent type, and new status.
  6. Return the created or updated consent record.

Entities

  • ConsentRecord
  • Patient
